summary: Fire camp in 1929, gabled L-4 cab built in 1932 on rock foundations, destroyed in 1960; rock foundations and debris still visible on a 4-mile hike.

facts.design: Gabled L-4 cab on rock foundations
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1960; rock foundations and debris remain at the site

staffing.status: Walt Lafon listed as staff for 1931 (Idaho Fire Lookouts); that year falls a year before the listed 1932 build

access.note: Hike-in on the Peak to Peak trail; the sources describe no closure

visit.trail_note: About a 4-mile hike on the Peak to Peak trail; the Idaho Fire Lookouts post suggests starting from the south

events.note: Site of a fire fighters' camp before the cab was built
Walt Lafon listed as known staff; the listing gives 1931, before the 1932 build date on the same page
Gabled L-4 cab built on rock foundations
Destroyed; the sources give no cause

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives a 1931 staffer, a year before its 1932 build date. The story reports the year as listed and flags the gap instead of changing either date.

notes_for_editor: Two sites agree on the 1932 build and the 1960 destruction. The 1931 staffer predates the 1932 build on the same listing, and the story flags this. Public access is inferred from the blog's hike-in trail description, not a Forest Service statement; worth checking with Coeur d'Alene National Forest. No new photos found.
